description: This file defines the TaskDatabase class responsible for managing SQLite database operations for a task management app. It includes methods to initialize the database, create tables, and perform CRUD operations on 'Task' objects stored in the database.

classes.name: TaskDatabase
classes.description: Singleton class to handle all database operations related to tasks, including creation, reading, updating, and deletion.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the initialized database instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: _initDB
methods.description: Initializes the database at the specified file path.

methods.name: _createDB
methods.description: Creates the tasks table in the database with appropriate schema.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new Task into the database.

methods.name: readNote
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Task by its ID.

methods.name: readAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all Tasks from the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Task by its ID.
